subject.title: Fix dashboard chat run recovery across reconnects

question: Should maintainers adopt or rewrite this stale branch on current main, ask the contributor to rebase and prove it, or close it after a viable replacement owns the linked Dashboard recovery issue?
rationale: The branch is conflicting and crosses protocol, shutdown, session-state, and UI lifecycle boundaries, so the remaining path is an ownership choice rather than one safe mechanical repair.

options.title: Adopt or replace on current main
options.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the useful recovery intent while using current filtered active-run helpers and restart-only shutdown semantics.

options.title: Ask for contributor rebase and proof
options.body: The original author can update the branch against current main and add redacted live Dashboard proof before another merge review.

options.title: Close after a viable replacement
options.body: If another PR becomes the clean, proof-positive fix path for the linked issue, this stale branch can close as superseded.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace on current main
recommendation.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the useful recovery intent while using current filtered active-run helpers and restart-only shutdown semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main Gateway/session lifecycle surfaces this branch must rebase onto are in his recent area of work.
